# Pull request

## Problem

Describe the concrete problem this change solves.

## Scope

List the files, requirements and contracts changed.

## Evidence

Show validation commands and material results.

## Risk

Describe privacy, security, compatibility, migration and performance impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the stated scope.
- [ ] Requirements and acceptance criteria are measurable.
- [ ] Traceability is updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] An ADR is included for a cross-cutting decision.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes update the threat model.
- [ ] `pnpm ci:local` and `pnpm guard:public` pass.
- [ ] Chrome and Firefox packaged builds pass.
- [ ] New fixtures include reviewed license and provenance metadata.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated or the omission is explained.
- [ ] No credential, personal browsing data or generated attribution trailer is included.
